page_title: FUL 0-3 BRE | Fulham v Brentford 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Darren Bond is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Rico Henry (Brentford) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+5' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
90+5' Issa Diop (Fulham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Brentford have a free kick.

90+2' 0 - 3 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes a short pass from Kristoffer Ajer in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot low into the middle of the goal. 0:3.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
89' It will be a substitution. Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Josh Dasilva walks off.
88' Josh Dasilva (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
86' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Raul Jimenez and he is replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kenny Tete trots off the pitch and is replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
85' Yellow card. Joao Palhinha (Fulham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
83' Willian (Fulham) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
82' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Fulham.
79' A substitution has been made. Yoane Wissa goes off and Josh Dasilva (Brentford) comes on.
79' Here is a change. Christian Norgaard is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford).
78' The game has come to an end for Aaron Hickey. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
77' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
76' Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
73' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) for Kevin Schade.
67' Here comes a substitution. Willian (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Andreas Pereira.
67' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Harrison Reed will be replaced by Calvin Bassey (Fulham).
67' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid is replaced by Joao Palhinha (Fulham).
67' Referee Darren Bond halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Marco Silva, then shows him a yellow.
66' 0 - 2 Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) brilliantly executes a penalty kick as he sends the ball straight into the bottom left corner, bouncing in off the post. No chance for Bernd Leno to stop this shot.
66' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
64' Tim Ream (Fulham) is given a yellow card by Darren Bond and because it's his second one today, the game is over for him.
64' Harrison Reed (Fulham) says more than he should have to the referee and is shown a yellow card.

64' Tim Ream (Fulham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren Bond no option but to blow his whistle. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Brentford!!
63' It will be a corner kick for Brentford.
61' Rico Henry (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren Bond had an easy-decision to make.
59' Harry Wilson (Fulham) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
55' Brentford take a short corner kick.
54' The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save as he denies the first-time effort by Mathias Jensen (Brentford) from the edge of the box. Now Brentford have a corner.

53' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
52' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
52' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will take the corner.
51' Kevin Schade (Brentford) makes a rough challenge and Darren Bond blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Tim Ream (Fulham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Yoane Wissa (Brentford), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
41' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
39' Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.
38' The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
38' The ball is out of play. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner.
36' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
35' A clumsy foul by Sasa Lukic (Fulham) and Darren Bond blows his whistle.
34' Harrison Reed (Fulham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
34' Fulham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
32' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
31' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
31' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Bernd Leno comes off his line to gather the ball.
30' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
29' The shot by Yoane Wissa (Brentford) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Bernd Leno.
28' The game is interrupted as Rico Henry (Brentford) is flagged offside.
27' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Vitaly Janelt.
24' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) tries to nod in a rebound. His close-range effort is denied by the goalkeeper, who pulls off a stunning save.
24' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) is penalised for holding. Darren Bond signals a set piece. Brentford will take a free kick.
23' Fulham will take a corner kick.
19' There's a distinct lack of options for Mathias Jensen (Brentford), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
15' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) meets a cross inside the box, but Bernd Leno wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
14' Darren Bond blows the whistle, Kevin Schade (Brentford) is penalised for a foul.
11' Great teamplay by Fulham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
6' The rebound finds Issa Diop (Fulham) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
6' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will deliver the corner kick.
3' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
3' Harry Wilson (Fulham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Darren Bond has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' The first half has just begun.
Fulham will kick the game off.
Darren Bond is the one to supervise the game today.
